tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description:
List every country and state in the authenticated subscription's Lawstronaut legal corpus (name, iso, type, documents_count) — not the global unfiltered catalog, and not legal documents or full text.

When to use: Call FIRST, before any jurisdiction-scoped legal query, so you know which iso codes ar

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description:
Lists the top-level legal domains (id, domain_id, domain name). This is the first taxonomy step. It does not return subdomains, categories, documents, or jurisdictions.

When to use: When you need the domain list or a name match. Examples: 'what legal domains exist?', 'find the domain for private la

tools.name: list_subdomains
tools.description:
Lists subdomains under one domain (id, domain_id, subdomain_id, subdomain name). This is the second taxonomy step.

When to use: When you already have a domain_id from list_domains. Examples: 'subdomains under domain A', 'international law under Private law'. Pass subdomain only to narrow by name. W

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description:
Lists categories under one subdomain, with the parent domain and subdomain names. This is the third taxonomy step.

When to use: When you already have a subdomain_id from list_subdomains. Examples: 'categories under subdomain A.1', 'find a category named jurisdiction'. Pass category_name only to nar

tools.name: list_subcategories
tools.description:
Lists subcategories under one category (id, category_id, category_name, subcategory_id, subcategory_name). This is the fourth taxonomy step.

When to use: When you already have a category_id from list_categories. Examples: 'subcategories of category A.1.1', 'find the Jurisdiction subcategory'. Pass

tools.name: list_law_types
tools.description:
Lists law types under one subcategory, with the parent category and subcategory names. This is the last taxonomy step. It does not return documents.

When to use: When you already have a subcategory_id from list_subcategories. Examples: 'law types under subcategory A.1.1.1', 'find law types named st

tools.name: list_portals
tools.description:
Lists the source portals available through this tool, with metadata such as jurisdiction and language. A jurisdiction may have multiple portals, including those maintained by regulators or ministries.

When to use: When you need portals, legal websites, or sources for a known iso. Pass optional name

tools.name: list_authority_types
tools.description:
Lists the authority types available through this tool, with metadata such as jurisdiction and portal name.

When to use: When you need authority types for a known iso. Pass optional portal name or authority type only to narrow that list. When not: Do not call without an iso from list_jurisdictions.

tools.name: list_issuing_authorities
tools.description:
Lists the issuing authorities available through this tool, with metadata such as jurisdiction and issuing authority.

When to use: When you need issuing authorities for a known iso. Pass optional portal name or issuing authority only to narrow that list. When not: Do not call without an iso from lis

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description:
Lists document metadata in a jurisdiction (title, dates, source, classification) with filters and pagination. It does not return the document body, a citation bundle, or a source-file URL.

When to use: When you need to find or browse documents before reading them. Example: 'which Belgian employment

tools.name: list_full_text
tools.description:
Returns the plain-text body of documents (id, uuid, version, text). This is the plain-text read: wording only, with no Markdown headings or lists, and no citation metadata.

When to use: When you need the body as plain text. Examples: 'quote the operative wording of this Belgian statute', 'give me t

tools.name: list_markdown
tools.description:
Returns the structured Markdown body of documents (id, uuid, version, markdown). Headings and lists stay intact. This is not plain text, not a citation bundle, and not a file URL.

When to use: When you need the body as structured Markdown. Examples: 'show this regulation with its article headings',

tools.name: document_presigned_url
tools.description:
Returns a temporary signed URL to the original source file (PDF or other stored file) for one document. The URL expires. This tool does not return the document body or a citation bundle.

When to use: When you need to open or download the original file. Examples: 'give me the PDF for uuid …', 'link

tools.name: document_version
tools.description:
Retrieves a specific document with a specific version

When to use: The user wants to find a specific document with a specific version When not: The user wants to find a specific document with a specific version but the document is not found

Parameters: uuid (required) is the UUID of the document,

tools.name: horizon_scan
tools.description:
Scans recent legal documents across jurisdictions.

When to use: When you need to find legal content for a specific jurisdiction and optional filters. When not: Do not use this to read a document body or download a file. For plain text use list_full_text. For structured Markdown use list_markdown. F

tools.name: evidence_pull
tools.description:
Returns one complete citation bundle for a single document: metadata, a permanent legal_link, a citation_template, the body, and a temporary source-file URL when one exists.

When to use: When one call must support a citation or an audit. Examples: 'show me the source for this Irish statute', 'cite

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Searches legal documents using OpenSearch to discover relevant documents based on the supplied search criteria. Returns matching documents and their available metadata.

When to use: Use when you need to discover relevant legal documents through search, especially when looking for documents matching

tools.name: health_check
tools.description:
Verify that the Lawstronaut MCP server and its backing services (database, cache) are reachable and responding. Returns the overall status, per-service status, server version, and a UTC timestamp.
